communications.subject: South Carolina Public Records Law Request: FOIA Requst - Hanshaw Emails
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the South Carolina Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

All emails and email attachments from the attached spreadsheet. These are emails that were responsive to a previous request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request be filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days for records less than 24-months old, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

M
